formula_checks.name: grossFromNet
formula_checks.why: A monotone federal-schedule inversion on the stated no-payroll/no-state domain; [net,3×net] brackets the 2026 rates, and50 bisections give ample numerical precision.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: progressiveMonthlyTax
formula_checks.why: Clipping negative income months to0 breaks the year-tax reconciliation when a legitimate loss lowers cumulative taxable income. This is an allocation illustration, not payroll withholding.
formula_checks.should_be: Restrict inputs to explicitly nonnegative accruals, or permit negative tax adjustments that telescope to tax on the actual annual base.

formula_checks.name: seniorDeductionFor
formula_checks.why: Per-person6% phaseout is correct, but unknown MAGI gives an actual0 rather than a missing eligibility result.
formula_checks.should_be: Keep MAGI unknown distinct from a fully phased-out deduction; disclose conditional estimate.

formula_checks.name: deductionFor
formula_checks.why: Correct statutory amounts on an eligible standard-deduction return; MAGI/eligibility missing and nonstandard filing constraints are not represented.
formula_checks.should_be: Declare standard-deduction model scope, provide MAGI for senior phaseout and preserve unknown eligibility.

formula_checks.name: taxableIncomeFor
formula_checks.why: Uses gross as MAGI; equivalent only when the caller has already adjusted gross to the statutory MAGI basis. Broad gross income can overphase the senior deduction.
formula_checks.should_be: Pass a distinct adjusted-income/MAGI value or explicitly constrain the model domain; do not phase the senior amount on unadjusted gross.

formula_checks.name: taxOwedFor
formula_checks.why: Correct2026 band-by-band standard-deduction-model tax, plus the explicitly user-entered flat state assumption on taxable income. Full-return tax treatments and MAGI domain remain outside this primitive.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: effectiveRateOnGrossFor
formula_checks.why: Divides the same modeled tax by its matching positive gross base; zero-income output is a rate sentinel, not proof of an entered0 tax rate.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: marginalBracketFor
formula_checks.why: Correct inclusive upper-bound marginal band lookup on the modeled ordinary taxable income; zero taxable income maps to first band by convention, not a positive tax bill.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: ltcgRateFor
formula_checks.why: Constants are correct, but one marginal rate selected from current ordinary income cannot price a finite gain that crosses the0/15/20% bands.
formula_checks.should_be: Label marginal baseline rate only; for tax on a gain, stack the gain over ordinary taxable income and slice it across bands.

formula_checks.name: needsTakeHomeConversion
formula_checks.why: Detects only a positive legacy take-home-mode record, without re-running conversion on already migrated data.
formula_checks.rests_on: Written purpose and formula, on the stated valid input domain; ordinary arithmetic

formula_checks.name: convertTakeHomeMode
formula_checks.why: The calculated-rate conversion inverts net to gross without adding back401(k) contributions, so the later gross−tax−401(k) cannot equal the typed take-home. Manual-rate branch handles401(k), calculated branch does not.
formula_checks.should_be: Solve gross−pre-tax contributions−tax(gross−pre-tax contributions)=entered net; store a labeled estimate once.

rules_held.why: This part does not supply the independent full contract needed to establish this decision. Cross-part findings are referenced,not treated as local measured app behavior. The legacy stored-income path still calculates monthlytax as single without state and differs from rateInForce.
rules_held.decision_in_force: The app carried TWO complete tax engines, both live from the same profile on the same day, and one of them could not read a filing status at all. One is deleted. ZERO numbers moved for a single filer — the two were identical arithmetic there — and it becomes correct for couples the moment the filing-status question lands.

rules_held.decision_in_force: NOT A DECISION OF HIS — the lead's decision of 2026-10-24 under his rulings DEC-3523 (tenets 3 and 5), made without asking him, as his order of 2026-09-30 says. A $5,000 take-home with the person's own 0% rate: the gross box showed 5475.378787878787, worked back from the federal tables, the card read Everything else taken out $475/month · 0%, and its last line said nothing there was calculated. The gross is now worked back with their own rate, $5,000.00, under the line "≈ Worked back from the take-home you entered. Type the gross from a payslip to replace it.", and the card's last line says the take-home is what was entered and the gross was worked back from it. The typed take-home is unchanged ($5,000 on This month). Typing a gross brings back the drawing's words. The drawing's rule 9: every estimate is prefixed ≈ and says what it cannot see. To reverse: work the gross back from the federal schedule and print the drawn words. One word from him reverses it.
